challenge.method: Compared BY-NC with BY, BY-NC-ND and BY-NC-SA. Checked the newer-edition notice and whether §4(e)’s mention of Japan identified a jurisdiction port.
challenge.results: The page says “CC BY-NC 3.0.” Section 4(b) contains the commercial-advantage wording, and §3(b) includes “to create and Reproduce Adaptations.” Japan appears as an example within the clause. The title expressly says Unported, the URL has no country segment, and the linked BY-NC 4.0 International edition has its own Index row.

limitations: Active concerns maintenance of this Index mapping only. It supplies no finding on publisher currency, legal effect, SPDX deprecation or release.
